condition_variants.hard_gates: 眺望點合法可達且安全；官方封閉/營運停止時不成立

variant_name_i18n.ja: バッドランズの悪地層と夜明け

required_conditions_i18n.zh-TW: 以 V2 契約條件為準（draft/provisional，未校準）
required_conditions_i18n.en: Judged by the V2 contract conditions (draft/provisional, uncalibrated).
required_conditions_i18n.ja: V2契約の条件に従う（draft/provisional、未校正）。

boosters_i18n.zh-TW: 惡地尖峰成層列隊向東延伸，無光害、低緯乾燥——沙層紋理要靠低角度光才能浮出，銀河需要乾燥晴夜。
boosters_i18n.en: Layered erosional spires of the Badlands wall line up to the east; the striped sediments only read in low-angle light, and the dark-sky core rewards dry clear nights.
boosters_i18n.ja: 悪地の侵食ピない連なりが東へ。堆積の縞模様は低角度光で浮かび、暗空の乾いた夜は銀河に向く。

penalties_i18n.zh-TW: 惡劣天候、能見度差、營運/季節窗外
penalties_i18n.en: Severe weather, poor visibility, outside operating/season window.
penalties_i18n.ja: 悪天候、視程不良、営業・季節窓外。

boosters_i18n.zh-TW: 口緣展望台望哈雷茂茂熔岩湖紅光映雲（USGS HVO 活動等級主導；長曝；SO2 火山霧（vog）下風向注意——安全 note；公園 24 小時開放但噴發期口緣區域可能管制——access 依現場公告）；與既有 us-112 哈雷茂茂夜空（銀河主題、噴發光 honest not_evaluatable）題材錯位——本點為熔岩紅光本體，且新增 REQUIRED volcanic_activity 條件接 USGS HVO 現況。
boosters_i18n.en: Lava-lake glow lighting the plume above Halemaʻumaʻu from the rim overlook, governed by USGS HVO activity state; long exposure; SO2/vog downwind caution - safety note; the park is open 24 h but rim areas may close during eruptive episodes - access follows on-site notices; disjoint from us-112's Milky-Way night-sky subject (glow there is honestly not_evaluatable) - here the lava glow itself, with a NEW REQUIRED volcanic_activity condition tied to USGS HVO status.
boosters_i18n.ja: 口縁展望台からハレマウマウの溶岩湖の紅光（USGS HVOの活動状態に支配される。長時間露光。SO2・火山ガスの風下注意。公園は24時間開放だが噴火期は規制あり）。us-112の天の川とは題材が別。

penalties_i18n.ja: 悪天候、視程不良、営業・季節窓外。
